intro: At Stormwind's gates, the Alliance gathers to mark a victory over Blackrock. After you report to Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in Stormwind Keep, the heroes go to the Valley of Heroes, where Field Marshal Stonebridge prepares a public commemoration for the city.
